newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cerebos completes food business purchase.
newsitem.headline: Cerebos completes food business purchase.

text.p: Cerebos Pacific Ltd has completed the acquisition of the business assets of Asian Home Gourmet Pte Ltd through subsidiary Ruby Food Traders Pte Ltd, said the company's financial adviser Bankers Trust Company, Singapore.
Another unit CUB (Hong Kong) Co Ltd has also completed the purchase of a 50 percent stake in Home Gourmet International Ltd from Home Gourmet Ltd.
Cerebos had announced the intended purchases in November.

Ruby Food Traders, to be renamed Asian Home Gourmet (CPL) Pte Ltd, and CUB will develop and market a range of Asian seasoning and spice pastes, salad dressing and pre-mixed dinner kits under the Asian Home Gourmet and Home Gourmet brand names.
